### problem_chain
Root (customer's only ask, persona: "you want to pay off whatever you still owe on the windows contract, today, by bank transfer"): `window_ext_final_balance_payoff` → `pay_final_balance_39e93918` (owner=user).
The payoff rule carries three prerequisite sentences; each checked on the raw DB at 2026-10-13:
1. "The payoff amount is fixed only after the contract's ledger carries a late balance charge for every full late period that has ended under the late-charge terms." Late-charge terms on this contract: clock start = lender funding date 2026-07-28 (financing contract, funded after completion 2026-07-23 — finance_accounts 27196484 `funded_date`); + 5 due days + 10 autopay grace (`autopay_enrolled: true`) + 7 one-delay goodwill (install_activities 5f7b303e `initiated_by: company`; factory order 30b248b8 shipped 2026-07-08 = committed 2026-07-08) → start 2026-08-19; one full period ended 2026-09-18. Window ledger has no `late_balance_charge` row → **false at opening**. Resolved by the late-charge policy.
2. "The payoff amount is not quoted until the ledger carries a change-order fee for every customer change order written beyond the series free count." Third customer change order 2026-05-28 is beyond free count 2; no `change_order_fee` row → **false**. Resolved by the change-order fee policy.
3. "Before the payoff amount is worked out, the ledger must carry a remeasure fee for every customer-requested remeasure beyond the series free remeasure count." Second customer remeasure 2026-05-27 beyond free count 1; no `remeasure_fee` row → **false**. Resolved by the remeasure fee policy.
- Derived tree: payoff ← {late charge, change-order fee, remeasure fee}; all three `value_input` (each raises `fees_on_contract`, hence the balance due). n = 3 prerequisite problems, 3 value_input edges ≥ max(2,1). No cycle. One owner=user write (the root).
- Load-bearing runs (skip one prerequisite write, recompute payoff): skip late charge → 3891.72; skip change-order fee → 3757.71; skip remeasure fee → 3839.01; all differ from 3911.52. Every edge bears weight.
- Parallel edges: the three fees share no balance/cap/dedup key and none reads the others (late-charge balance = price + change-order lines − credits − net payments, fees excluded); any order of the three gives the same terminal state.
- Tools do not judge prerequisites: `pay_final_balance_39e93918` body only `ctx.find`s the contract for `customer_id` and creates the payment row; no status/fee check, no error path (`task_tools.py` lines 41–55). Same for the three fee tools.
- Persona raises only the root; nothing names or hints at a fee, a late charge, a change order or a remeasure. Its conditional lines ("If the representative tells you that some charges have to go on your account before your payoff can be figured, you say that is fine…"; "If they tell you part of the installation charges will be held back … that sounds fair") are passive reactions to the agent's statements, not steers. The facts offered only on request (missing screen and caulking reported in October; a sash part on order under warranty) are already in the DB (install_activities 5fc214b8, 2e160f70; warranty_activities 0199e321). Persona closes on the payment being recorded — the last write.
- Topological order: {late charge, change-order fee, remeasure fee} in any order → payoff.

## findings
- **T0-1 — SOURCE-FACTOR RED (mislabelled effect; late-charge computation has no honest `method` factor).** Symptom: step 11's computation declares one `method` factor, `late_clock_anchor`, whose three tiers only pick which date the period count starts from. Root cause: charter-global finding `_difficulty.md` § findings G1 (G1a), factor block `window.extended.yaml` lines 1950–1964. Evidence: compute lines 1896, 1902–1903 — every tier feeds the same `DAYS(late_clock_start, NOW) - P('final_balance_due_days') - payment_grace_days - company_delay_goodwill_days` then `// 30`. Demonstrated consequence on this world: the tier taken (funding date 2026-07-28) and the baseline (completion 2026-07-23) differ only by the 5-day input to that one expression (77 vs 82 days → 55 vs 60 → 1 vs 2 periods → 19.80 vs 39.60); no tier changes the algorithm. Counting honest labels, step 11 has 0 `method` factors against the floor of 1. Affected: `window_ext_late_balance_charge.factors`, `computations[0].factor_trace[0]` ("late_clock_anchor (method)"). Relation to previous revisions: first audit.
- **T0-2 — SOURCE-CHAIN RED (proof assertion contradicts recomputation; no scoring consequence).** Symptom: `prerequisite_closure.edges[0].unresolved_at_frozen_time.why_false` = "One full late period has ended (late-charge start 2026-08-18, period end 2026-09-17)…", repeated in `design_rationale` card E1 ("late-charge start 2026-08-18 (funding 2026-07-28 + 5 due days + 10 autopay grace + 7 goodwill), one full period ended 2026-09-17"). Root cause: off-by-one in the author's date arithmetic. Evidence: 2026-07-28 + 22 calendar days = 2026-08-19 under the rule sentence "The late-charge start date is the clock start plus the series final-balance due days plus a payment grace and a company-delay goodwill, all counted in calendar days"; the compute's own 55 elapsed days place the start at 2026-08-19. Demonstrated consequence: the asserted world fact is false; the number of ended periods (1) and the catch-up tier (25 days, aging) are unchanged, so no scored value moves. Affected: `tasks/0.json` prerequisite_closure edge 0 why_false; design_rationale E1. First audit.
- Observations (no RED): G3 (repeat-remeasure fall-through unreachable in the 3300 series, two live tiers here); the seed's un-booked change-order and remeasure fees are the task's premise (base would have charged them when written) — consistent with the extended catch-up design, not a cross-category state; the persona's two passive conditional lines are reactions, not steers; GT also reads warranty claims, a read the derivation did not need (warranty activities suffice) — harmless.

Per-task verdict: **SOURCE-FACTOR RED (T0-1), SOURCE-CHAIN RED (T0-2, proof text only); policy self-consistency PASS on this world; unique solution PASS.**
